subject: MAP Kickoff: Novago evaluation & timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novago.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@novago.com
Date: 2026-03-01T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Novago evaluation & timeline

Hi Liam (and Novago team),

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to get the evaluation moving. Per our agreement I'd like to kick off a mutual action plan (MAP) so we have clear owners, deliverables, and a close timeline that aligns to Novago's pilot goals. Goal is to run a two-week evaluation (technical + business), with a decision point by the end of March.

Proposed kickoff: March 4, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45 min)
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: novago-eval)
Calendar hold (ICS attached): cal_hold.ics

Draft agenda (please suggest edits):
- 5 min: Intros & roles — who is the decision maker, procurement contact, technical champion
- 10 min: Success criteria & acceptance test (what does a successful pilot look like?)
- 10 min: Evaluation plan overview — test dataset, performance targets, telemetry/access
- 7 min: Security/compliance checklist and documentation handoff (SOC 2, data handling)
- 5 min: Timeline & milestones (deliverables, procurement steps, signatures)
- 3 min: Next steps and action items (owners + dates)

Attachments: Novago_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (MAP template w/ timeline and owner columns)

Ask: Please confirm who from your side should be on the call (name + role), and whether the proposed time works. If not, propose a window and we'll accommodate. Also flag any additional materials you want us to prepare for the kickoff (sample prompts, example telemetry dashboards, or a short security packet).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novago.com>

Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Novago evaluation & timeline

Marissa — thanks, this looks great.

On Mon, Mar 1, 2026 at 9:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed kickoff: March 4, 2026 at 10:00 AM PT (30–45 min)
> Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (passcode: novago-eval)

I can confirm interest from our side. Attendees I expect to join:
- Maya Singh — CTO (final technical approver)
- Duncan Reed — Dev Lead (will coordinate test dataset and run integration)
- Procurement (procurement@novago.com) — will join for the timeline/procurement milestones

One ask from procurement: before contract review they need current SOC 2 type II and confirmation on data residency for logs. Can you attach the SOC 2 snapshot or point me to a short packet?

Also, the 10:00 AM PT time is a bit tight for our UK-based CTO — would 11:00 AM PT (2:00 PM ET) on March 4 work for Redwood? If so we can lock it.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Senior Product Manager
Novago Health
liam@novago.com | +1 (617) 555-3742

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@novago.com
Date: 2026-03-01T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Novago evaluation & timeline

Thanks Liam — 11:00 AM PT on March 4 works for us.

Marissa: I'll update the MAP with the tentative owners and revised timeline. Dev Patel will be the technical liaison and will own the test environment setup and sample prompts. He will also coordinate with Duncan on dataset access.

On the SOC 2 ask: we have a current SOC 2 Type II snapshot and a short security brief — I'll attach a link in the follow-up. For the kickoff please expect a one-slide summary of our compliance posture and a pointer to the audit pack under NDA.

Quick notes for the kickoff logistics:
- Updated start: March 4, 2026 — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (30–45 min)
- Zoom remains: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210 (will enable waiting room)
- Attendees from Redwood: Marissa Cole (AE), Rishi Malhotra (SE Exec), Dev Patel (Infra/Integration)
- Novago attendees: Liam O'Connor, Maya Singh (CTO), Duncan Reed (Dev Lead), Procurement

I will also add a brief acceptance criteria section to the MAP workbook so we can capture performance targets (latency, throughput, and quality checks).

-Rishi
